_comment: Single source of truth for theSaver model classification. Both the bash hook and JS plugin load this file. Tier IDs (high/mid/budget) are stable — display labels are user-facing.

trinity._comment: Per-slot models for both runtimes. `oc` writes to the OpenCode config. `cc` writes to the CC config. Adjust to match your available models.

selection._comment: Used by `trinity auto`: pick `brain` slot when credit ≥ threshold, else `fallback` slot. Dropping to mid slot at low credit is more reliable than burning what's left on flaky brain calls. `enabled` toggles all theSaver logic. `active_slot` records the last slot set by `trinity`.

high.label: brain
high.behavior: warn on Edit/Write/Bash with savings estimate; ledger; context7 nudge; scratchpad observe
